subject.title: feat(ui): calm the working claw, rare stances, wait phrases, turn recap

question: Should Control UI ship a turn recap that can misattribute another same-session completion to a queued or cancelled send, or should the recap wait for a terminal-row run identifier?
rationale: The source documents this as an accepted residual rather than a mechanically settled behavior; choosing between a smaller cosmetic feature now and extending the gateway/session contract is a maintainer product and correctness decision.

options.title: Add exact run correlation
options.body: Carry a terminal run identifier through the relevant gateway/session row and render a recap only when it matches the watched run.

options.title: Land animation and phrases only
options.body: Remove the recap path from this PR and preserve the independent working-indicator polish until exact correlation is available.

options.title: Accept the cosmetic ambiguity
options.body: Deliberately ship the documented settle-window behavior, accepting occasional incorrect recap attribution in the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Add exact run correlation
recommendation.body: Carry a terminal run identifier through the relevant gateway/session row and render a recap only when it matches the watched run.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR description frames and documents the tradeoff, making this person the best available routing candidate for the immediate design decision.
